candidates.spoken: It caused chemical burns to people and animals.
A flood of red mud swept through nearby villages.
The Ajka alumina reservoir flooded villages with caustic red mud.
A reservoir wall at a Hungarian alumina plant suddenly broke.
After Ajka, hungary tightened industrial waste reservoir regulation.
The mud wasn't just dirty water.
The mud was waste from making aluminium.
It flowed into rivers and reached the Danube.
The reservoir had been inspected shortly before.
Hungary then tightened rules for industrial waste reservoirs.
a corner of a waste reservoir wall giving way.
It started with red mud stored behind dyke. It ended with rivers contaminated.

script.spoken: It caused chemical burns to people and animals. A reservoir wall at a Hungarian alumina plant suddenly broke. A flood of red mud swept through nearby villages, and ten people were killed. The mud was waste from making aluminium. It was strongly alkaline. It flowed into rivers and reached the Danube. The reservoir had been inspected shortly before. Hungary then tightened rules for industrial waste reservoirs.
